rate_limits.correction: The published api.data.gov defaults are 1,000 requests/hour for a registered key and, for DEMO_KEY, 30 requests/hour per IP address plus 50 requests/day per IP address. Limits may vary by service, but no authoritative ERS source supporting a limit of 10 was located.

notes: Current ERS documentation confirms the REST root, /arms/year request, JSON and GraphQL access, ARMS subject matter, and free api.data.gov key registration. The claimed DEMO_KEY limit of 10 conflicts with the currently published 30/hour and 50/day defaults and lacks an ERS source. ERS does not publish a CORS policy; api.data.gov documents CORS as backend-specific configuration.
